title: T2 — body in a flow box
request: A 40 mm diameter sphere in an open air flow, for an external aerodynamics solve. Put it in a domain that extends 5 diameters upstream, 15 downstream, and 5 to each side and above and below. Name the inlet, the outlet, the far field and the sphere separately. Resolve the boundary layer on the sphere with prism layers.
properties: domain extent in diameters, upstream / downstream / lateral: 5 / 15 / 5
blockage ratio — sphere frontal area over domain cross-section
achieved layer coverage on the sphere, as a percentage, **read off the mesh**

run.tail:
verified. Summary:

**Case:** `/work/20260911-115012-431e/bash-t2`

**Geometry:** 40 mm diameter sphere (r = 0.02 m) centered at the origin, inside a rectangular domain sized off the diameter:
- inlet at x = −0.2 m (5D upstream)
- outlet at x = +0.6 m (15D downstream)
- far-field sides/top/bottom at y,z = ±0.2 m (5D each way)

Built with `build123d` (sphere STL) + `/work/.toolbox/cfmesh.py box` to close it inside the flow box, one ASCII multi-solid STL with named solids (sphere, inlet, outlet, yMin/yMax/zMin/zMax → merged into `farField`).

**Mesh:** cfMesh `cartesianMesh`, background cell 20 mm, refined to ~2.5 mm at the sphere surface, 5 prism/boundary layers (growth ratio 1.2) extruded off the sphere wall. Four named patches came out exactly as intended:

| patch | type | faces |
|---|---|---|
| sphere | wall | 1,360 |
| inlet | patch | 484 |
| outlet | patch | 484 |
| farField | patch | 3,696 |

32,528 cells total (31,528 hex + 1,000 polyhedra from the layer/octree transition, 0 degenerate).

**Verification done, not assumed:**
- `checkMesh -allGeometry` → **Mesh OK** (max non-orthogonality 25.2°, max skewness 0.52, max aspect ratio 8.6 — all comfortably inside the usual pass thresholds).
- Boundary-layer coverage measured against a same-mesh no-layer reference build (not just the mesher's own say-so): **100.0% of sphere faces** carry a layer-thinned first cell, ~11.7× thinner (median) than the no-layer wall spacing — first-cell height 0.14–0.19 mm.
- `mesh_look.py` render (`look.png`, left in the case dir and visible to you already) confirms the enclosure shape, patch identity, and that refinement is concentrated on the sphere and into its wake toward the outlet.

Not yet done, since this was a meshing request: no fields/BCs/solver setup — `0/`, `constant/transportProperties`, `turbulenceProperties`, a real `f  meshing cartesianMesh-sphere · 1 s

vSchemes`/`fvSolution` for whatever solver (`simpleFoam`/`incompressibleFluid` etc.) — the `system/controlDict,fvSchemes,fvSolution` currently in the case are minimal stubs cfMesh needed to run, not a solver-ready set.
